Kimseyi suçlayamam ancak böyle bir olay oldu şüphe uyandırdı başka kimse yaşamasın
Oct 2025 • Solo
On October 30, 2025, at 5:42 PM local time in Vietnam, 
I made a contactless payment using my credit card at YASHODA INDIAN RESTAURANT located at 
119 Nguyễn Thiện Thuật, Tân Tiến, Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa 650000, Vietnam
The transaction amount was 240,000 Vietnamese Dong (approximately _USD 9.11_). During contactless payment, the POS device took too long to process the transaction. This transaction was made by me, and my credit card was physically in my possession at the time.

However, approximately three hours after this transaction, a second transaction was processed on my credit card for _TRY 174,714_ (approximately _USD 4,156_)—without any verification code being sent to my phone and without my authorization. My credit card was still physically with me, and I did not initiate or approve this transaction.

After the initial payment at the restaurant, the waiter asked me to write my name on the slip taken from the credit card terminal. I complied, trusting the process, but was not given a copy of the slip. Considering the high-value unauthorized transaction that occurred shortly afterward, I suspect that my card details may have been copied without my consent by the restaurant staff. I was asked to write my name, not provide a signature, which leads me to believe that my name may have been collected to facilitate fraudulent use of my card information.
Moreover, when I spoke with the restaurant owner, he told me that he also took names from other customers in this way. He said this was common in Vietnam. This is a complete lie. I've been to Vietnam four times in the last three years, staying for extended periods, and I've never encountered such a practice. I've also been in Nha Trang for 10 days. I use my credit card every day for food, markets, and restaurants. He's never taken names here or in any other city in Vietnam. Only this establishment has. And that's made me even more suspicious.

We know the Brits like good Indian food, so we followed their reviews
Aug 2025 • Couples
We received a menu in English, and we were asked how spicy when ordering. The staff spoke good English and repeated the order to us. Between 2 adults we ate, 1serve of lentil soup, 1 serve of butter naan, 1 serve of butter chicken and 1 serve of steamed rice. There was a very good amount of quality tender chicken in the butter chicken. All serves were very generous, and we couldn’t eat all the food. We were given free water and a starter of papadums with 3 sauces. We really enjoyed the food and the service and highly recommend this restaurant particularly given Indian isn’t our first choice of cuisines.
